description: 11e multi-detachment army building (Detachment Points pool). server/tests/e2e-multi-detachment.mjs drives the browser Army Builder: Custodes 2000 pts, primary Lions of the Emperor + Solar Watch + Null Maiden Vigil (3 / 3 DP; the 3 DP Guardians of the Throne is refused), a warlord Shield-Captain with Sally Forth (Solar Watch), saved to the cloud as MULTI_DET_E2E_Custodes. This scenario loads it through the main menu (Refresh Cloud Armies; P1's Force Disposition dropdown follows the army — Reconnaissance, the army's pick, selected and the dispositions no selected detachment gives greyed out; Start Game): the army carries all three detachments and their DP, 11e construction validation raises no DP or foreign-enhancement warning, the Shield-Captain carries Sally Forth and its datasheet shows it, the primary is faction.detachment, all three detachments are active (FactionAbilityManager), the stratagems of all three load, and Solar Watch (taken second) gives the Favoured Ka'tah Calistus.

steps.comment: the driver's temporary server_config.json points at the e2e relay server
Player 1 picks the cloud army in the dropdown; both seats human
steps.script:
var main = tree.current_scene
var idx := -1
for i in range(main.army_options.size()):
	if str(main.army_options[i].id) == "MULTI_DET_E2E_Custodes":
		idx = i
main.player1_dropdown.select(idx)
main.player1_dropdown.item_selected.emit(idx)
main.player1_type_dropdown.select(0)
main.player1_type_dropdown.item_selected.emit(0)
main.player2_type_dropdown.select(0)
main.player2_type_dropdown.item_selected.emit(0)
return main.player1_dropdown.get_item_text(main.player1_dropdown.selected).contains("Cloud")

steps.comment: the menu prefetches the cloud army to read its detachments
P1 Force Disposition follows the army: its own pick (Reconnaissance) selected; Take and Hold / Purge the Foe / Priority Assets greyed out (none of Lions / Solar Watch / Null Maiden Vigil gives them)
screenshot framing: open the P1 disposition dropdown popup so the greyed-out items are visible
steps.script:
var dd: OptionButton = tree.current_scene.p1_disposition_dropdown
dd.show_popup()
return true

steps.comment: the downloaded cloud army carries all three detachments + their DP (3 / 3)
11e construction validation: no DP-pool warning and the Solar Watch enhancement is NOT flagged as foreign to the (primary) Lions of the Emperor detachment
the Shield-Captain in game carries Sally Forth (a Solar Watch enhancement)
the primary detachment is the game's active detachment
every selected detachment is active in game (faction block + FactionAbilityManager)
stratagems of all three detachments are loaded for P1
Solar Watch (a Shield Host detachment taken second) gives the Favoured Ka'tah: Calistus
screenshot framing only: the Battle Formations dialog (an exclusive popup) is hidden so the datasheet is readable; it is shown again after the screenshot
steps.script:
var fd = tree.current_scene.formations_dialog
if fd == null or not is_instance_valid(fd) or not fd.visible:
	return 0
fd.set_meta("_mdet_hidden", true)
fd.hide()
return 1

steps.comment: open the Shield-Captain's datasheet (the I-key card)

steps.script:
tree.current_scene.get_node("DatasheetModal").close()
var fd = tree.current_scene.formations_dialog
if fd != null and is_instance_valid(fd) and fd.has_meta("_mdet_hidden"):
	fd.remove_meta("_mdet_hidden")
	fd.show()
return true
